name: Master Vault
design_intent:
N2 circuit (hard navigation, owner 2026-07-16) course 5/5 CAPSTONE: TWO KEYS, TWO DOORS, TWO SKILLS. Door 'a' is opened by a key at the top of a 1800px chimney climb (Wall Climb's verb); door 'b' by a key floating just past a 180px needle mouth (Needle Thread's verb). Both doors span void-line to past-ceiling, so the order is forced: climb -> door a -> thread (key b sits in the thread line) -> door b -> goal. Longest n2 course (~4700px of forced-order navigation).

MOVEMENT MATH (current Tuning): trampoline apex 270, zero-boost drift ~395 (trampoline) / ~527 (spring); boost 760 px/s at 28.6 fuel/s (~26.6px/fuel); touch +20; super 2800 => apex ~2450px above launch.

FLIGHT-REQUIRED PROOF (every leg): start->chimney base (320->940) 620px, pad2->needle wall (2420->3040) 620px, pad3->goal (3600->4300) 700px, base->pad2 (1260->2100) 840px with door a at x1700 -- ALL exceed the 527px spring drift ceiling (pads are trampolines, reach ~395). KEY A CLIMB: shaft interior x 940..1260 (320px vs 92px player) directly above the base pad; L1 (y=-100) is 1300px above the pad (4.8x trampoline apex), L2 (y=-650) is 550px above L1 (> 480 spring apex), key a (y=-1000) is 350px above L2 (> 270 trampoline apex -- final boost puff). KEY B THREAD: mouth y 700..880 (180px, 44px clearance/side) sits 320-500px above pad2's 730 bounce apex line at a 620px standoff -- aimed flight only; key b (x 3260, y 790) hangs 100px past the mouth exit dead-center in the thread line, so collecting it IS threading it.

FUEL LEDGER: key-a climb from a multi-bounce-full tank: 1300px ~= 49 fuel, +20 at L1, 550px ~= 21, +20 at L2, 350px ~= 13 => worst point 51, ~37 left at the key; fall out free, re-bank on base pad. Door-a leg 840px ~= 31 fuel. Needle leg (climb ~400 + cross 620 + wall 120) ~= 45 fuel from a full pad2 bank. Door-b leg 700px ~= 26. Every leg is single-tank with a refund stop before it. Falls -> void line (y 1500) -> free respawn at start_gate; keys already collected stay collected, so a fall costs travel time only.

DOOR/CEILING FENCES: both doors and the needle's upper wall run y=-3200..(floor), i.e. 300px PAST the -2900 ceiling -- zero overfly band. Ceiling -2900: vertical super from the pads (y=1200) apexes -1250, 1650px below it (safe); super from L2 (-650) would apex -3100 and rings out at -2900 (the fence; free respawn); the best diagonal super from the shaft (45 deg, components ~1980) crests only ~1225px above launch => -1875 from L2, far below the -3200 door tops. Doors each have exactly one matching key (a, b) -- never zero.

BOUNDS: explicit -- left -700, top -2900, right 5400, bottom 2100.
